name: update-issue
description: Updates a Linear issue: moves it to another workflow state (In Progress, Done), assigns or unassigns it, changes its priority, replaces its labels or renames it. The issue comes from linear__list-my-issues, linear__find-issues or linear__get-issue, the state from linear__list-workflow-states (one of the issue's own team), the assignee from linear__list-users and the labels from linear__list-labels.

id.description: The issue's identifier, like ENG-123, or its id, from linear__list-my-issues, linear__find-issues or linear__get-issue.

stateId.description: The workflow state to move the issue to: a state's id from linear__list-workflow-states, of the issue's own team.

assigneeId.description: Who to assign the issue to: a user's id from linear__list-users, or null to unassign it.

priority.description: Priority: 0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 medium, or 4 low.

labelIds.description: The issue's labels, replacing the ones it has: label ids from linear__list-labels.
